# Bundled typography

Unmodified Latin WOFF2 files from the IBM Plex family, distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Notices are included alongside the files.

- IBM Plex Sans variable normal, weights 100–700: `@fontsource-variable/ibm-plex-sans@5.3.0`.
- IBM Plex Mono normal, weights 400, 500 and 700: `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono@5.3.0`.
- Upstream: https://github.com/IBM/plex

Only these font assets are shipped. No external font request is needed. Scripts not covered by the Latin files use system fallbacks.
